videos.script: Lesson 7 ended with an escalation. This lesson is what happens when somebody reads it and says: this is an incident. {{declare}} Saying it changes things. A clock starts. A record opens. Evidence stops being optional. Then the incident needs a name: what kind it is, and how serious. {{classify}} And it needs edges. Which accounts, which machines, which data. {{scope}} Scope is a claim, and the half people forget is the evidence for what is outside it. Last, the timeline: every source in one list, in one time zone, from the first guess to the last login. {{timeline}}
